name: Resend
summary: Resend is an email sending service built for developers, with React-based templates and a simple API.

free_plan_covers.note: Free plan sends 3,000 emails a month, capped at 100 emails a day, across up to 3 verified domains.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Pro plan starts at $20/month for 50,000 emails a month and removes the 100/day cap.

portability.note: Resend supports standard SMTP as well as its own API and SDK, so switching providers mainly means changing SMTP credentials.

sdk_typescript.note: The official resend npm package is TypeScript-first and is what Resend's own Next.js guide uses.

setup.step: Create a free Resend account and add and verify a sending domain in the dashboard.
Install the SDK with npm install resend.
Create an API key in the dashboard and add it to your environment file.
In a server route, create a Resend client and call resend.emails.send() with an address on your verified domain.

builder_notes: Only send from an address on a verified domain; an unverified domain can only send test emails to the account owner.
Keep RESEND_API_KEY server-side; call resend.emails.send() from server code, never from the browser.
